{"consolidated_memory":"FLAPPING FLAG IN PLATFORM/FEATUREFLAGS/EVAL.GO — MULTIPLE OCCASIONS

Component: platform/featureflags/eval.go (platform side)
Stack: Go
Test Coverage: platform/featureflags/eval_test.go
General Problem: flapping flag in the flag evaluator
General Repro: evaluate the same flag for one user repeatedly
General Signal: a decision that alternates between calls

This recurring issue manifested in FIVE SEPARATE OCCASIONS, each with distinct triggers, root causes, and fixes:

OCCASION 1 — 2026-05-22 (c012-e2)
- Trigger: only for records carrying non-ASCII names
- Root Cause: unbounded retry loop with no backoff
- Fix: capped the attempts and added exponential backoff with jitter
- PR: #5946 on branch fix/flapping-flag-3
- Result: nightly rollup matched the source counts for 92 days running

OCCASION 2 — 2026-06-17 (c012-e3)
- Trigger: only after a rolling restart of the fleet
- Root Cause: two writes that were never wrapped in a transaction
- Fix: wrapped both writes in one transaction
- PR: #5953 on branch fix/flapping-flag-4
- Result: p99 latency fell from 9.4 s to 329 ms

OCCASION 3 — 2026-06-18 (c012-e4)
- Trigger: only when two requests raced on the same key
- Root Cause: floating point rounding in the money path
- Fix: moved the arithmetic to integer minor units
- PR: #7355 on branch fix/flapping-flag-5
- Result: throughput rose 63 percent, to 818 requests per second

OCCASION 4 — 2026-07-06 (c012-e5)
- Trigger: only for users sitting in a negative UTC offset
- Root Cause: an N+1 query hidden behind a lazy relation
- Fix: prefetched the relation in a single query
- PR: #7567 on branch fix/flapping-flag-6
- Result: 40 duplicate rows a day stopped being written

OCCASION 5 — 2026-07-22 (c012-e7)
- Trigger: only for traffic arriving through the corporate proxy
- Root Cause: an off-by-one in the slice bound
- Fix: corrected the bound and added a property test around it
- PR: #8993 on branch fix/flapping-flag-8
- Result: the backlog cleared 65 minutes after the deploy"}
